newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill cuts three European oil cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Merrill cuts three European oil cos.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch downgraded its short-term recommendations on shares in French oil companies Elf Aquitaine and Total SA and Italy's ENI SpA.
-- The brokerage said it lowered its short-term recommendation on Elf to accumulate from buy, but retained its long-term buy recommendation. Shares fell one to 42-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange.
-- On Total, the firm cut its short-term rating to neutral from accumulate, but again retained its long-term buy recommendation. The stock fell 3/4 to 39-3/8 on the New York Stock Exchange.

-- Merrill said it lowered its short-term view of ENI to neutral from accumulate, but maintained its long-term accumulate rating. Shares on the New York stock exchange gained 1/4 to 51-1/8 by mid-morning.
-- Merrill Lynch's oil analysts were not immediately available to comment on the rating changes.
